_comment: Arm B1 manifest. Minimal factual hints. Each entry describes ONLY what's in the section. No workflow guidance.

hints.scope: One-paragraph framing of what the project is and isn't
hints.stack: Runtime, framework, test deps, module system, npm scripts
hints.directory_layout: File tree with one-line purpose per file
hints.data_models: User shape and request/response shapes for the endpoints
hints.endpoints: REST routes with methods, paths, status codes, and response shapes
hints.style: Code conventions: async/await, middleware, id generation, naming
hints.testing: vitest + supertest patterns and required test cases
hints.success_criteria: Graded checklist — what the assertion scorer checks
